newsitem.title: USA: IFE in talks with Disney - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: IFE in talks with Disney - WSJ.

text.p: International Family Entertainment Inc, owner of the Family Channel that is being courted by News Corp Ltd, has had talks recently with another possible suitor: Walt Disney Co, the Wall Street Journal said.

In Tuesday's electronic edition, the Journal quoted an unnamed source familiar with the situation as saying Disney recently held acquisition talks with IFE, which is controlled by Pat Robertson and his family.

Other sources recently said News Corp made an offer valued at more than $1 billion. The Journal said Wall Street's view is that Robertson may be hoping talks with Disney can be used as leverage to get a better deal from News Corp.
